caption: The same 200 ms request and 100 ms reply on both lines. Half-duplex inserts two 20 ms turnarounds and takes 340 ms; full-duplex drops them and takes 300 ms, so 40 ms (about 11.8 %) is lost.

spec.aria: A timeline in milliseconds comparing one request-reply exchange: the half-duplex line runs request 0 to 200, a 20 ms turn, reply 220 to 320, another 20 ms turn, ending at 340 ms; the full-duplex line runs request 0 to 200 and reply 200 to 300, ending at 300 ms; a third lane marks the 40 ms from 300 to 340 as lost time.
